title: Chapter 449: Maris Is Seriously Injured
content:
Chapter 449: Maris Is Seriously Injured

After all, he has a group of teammates behind him who need his protection.

After Maris hovered at high altitude for a while, he dived and grabbed Gong Zheng and others.

If this claw were caught, then taken high into the air and thrown down, even a high-ranking general would probably be seriously injured.

At the same time, the attack of the dragon claw is comparable to that of a sword, penetrating the body with ease.

Just when Nares was about to approach the crowd, Gong Zheng slightly bent his legs and jumped directly towards Maris, who was low in the air.

Gong Zheng punched out, and Marius firmly grasped Gong Zheng's fist with both claws.

Zhao Bond and others quickly launched an attack.

Various attacks hit Maris, causing him to roar in pain.

Good found the opportunity and shot Maris' paw with an arrow. Although it did not penetrate, it hit his paw with great force.

He grabbed Gong Zheng's giant claw and let go immediately in pain.

Maris's dive did not take any advantage.

Instead, he endured the attack forcefully.

Then, he turned around and spit out a mouthful of flames, which made Zhao Bond and the others panic for a while.

Wang Shuo looked at the fighting here and felt a little anxious.

At this time, the anger he had accumulated was not enough to send out Shura Slash that was enough to defeat Maris.

He could only be patient and continue to kill ordinary monsters.

On the Great Wall, a large number of monsters have crossed the wall, and the soldiers guarding the city are at a disadvantage.

A large number of soldiers were devoured by monsters.

Wang Shuo saw it in his eyes and felt anxious in his heart.

He looked at the overall situation and focused on Maris.

Ten minutes later, Wang Shuo finally felt that his anger was enough.

He immediately approached Marius.

Just as Maris dived, Wang Shuo, under the cover of Gong Zheng, jumped onto the back of the pterosaur Maris.

Standing on the back of the pterosaur, it is basically impossible for the moves to be missed.

Maris shook violently and even spun in the air, trying to throw Wang Shuo down.

Wang Shuo had no choice but to put away his spear and hold on to the pterosaur's body tightly, using the hard horns to prevent him from being thrown off the dragon's body.

Maris was extremely angry about Wang Shuo climbing on him.

It was like a cockroach was crawling on our backs, and it made Maris sick to the core.

I just want to shake it off.

So Maris took Wang Shuo and flew high into the sky, spinning, diving, and rising in various ways.

But Wang Shuo stuck firmly to the dragon's body and didn't move at all.

"Wang Shuo, get down here."

Maris yelled hysterically.

"Okay, fly lower. If you are so high, I will definitely be thrown to death."

Naris dived toward the ground.

Wang Shuo took advantage of Maris not moving, and immediately took out the Shura Demon Breaking Spear and performed "Shura Slash".

Maris immediately became alert.

But it was a little late.

A huge light blade sliced open Maris's back.

The dead souls of Maris appeared in great numbers, and they immediately launched their strongest defense.

The horn on his back quickly turned into hard dragon scales, each piece shining with fiery red light.

The light blade struck the dragon scale and encountered a huge obstacle.

But he still cut the dragon scales open.

Almost cutting Maris in half.

Maris was like a stone thrown into the sky, falling rapidly.

Wang Shuo's move caused Maris to be seriously injured again.

It seems easy, but it is actually very dangerous.

If anyone wasn't careful, Wang Shuo might be the one who died.

"boom!"

The huge impact sound stirred up countless dust.

Maris fell to the ground, with extremely horrific wounds.
